installation.script:
#!/bin/ash

# Set working directory
cd /mnt/server || exit 1
apk --update add git unzip curl || { echo "Failed to install packages"; exit 1; }

# Clone Arixbyte's base configs
if git clone https://github.com/justyadav/arixbyte-egg.git ./temp; then
    cp -r ./temp/nginx ./temp/php-fpm ./temp/webroot ./temp/start.sh /mnt/server/
    chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh
    rm -rf ./temp
else
    echo "Failed to clone repository"; exit 1
fi

# Prepare directories
mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp /mnt/server/logs /mnt/server/webroot

# WordPress installation
if [ "${WORDPRESS}" = "true" ] || [ "${WORDPRESS}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "Installing WordPress..."
    cd /mnt/server/webroot || exit 1
    curl -fLO https://wordpress.org/latest.zip && unzip latest.zip && mv wordpress/* . && rm -rf wordpress latest.zip
    echo "WordPress installed. Visit http://ip:port/wp-admin"
    exit 0
fi

# NamelessMC installation
if [ "${NAMELESSMC}" = "true" ] || [ "${NAMELESSMC}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "Installing NamelessMC..."
    cd /mnt/server/webroot || exit 1
    curl -L https://github.com/NamelessMC/Nameless/releases/latest/download/nameless-deps-dist.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C /mnt/server/webroot
    cd /mnt/server/nginx/conf.d && rm -f default.conf
    curl -LO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justyadav/arixbyte-egg/main/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
    exit 0
fi

# Git clone if address provided
if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    cd /mnt/server/webroot || exit 1
    [ "${GIT_ADDRESS##*.}" != "git" ] && GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
    if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS#https://}"
    fi
    if [ -n "$(ls -A . 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        echo "Webroot not empty. Skipping clone."
    else
        if [ -n "${BRANCH}" ]; then
            git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
        else
            git clone "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
        fi
    fi
fi

echo "Installation complete. Visit http://ip:port/"
